The findings suggest that the secret may lie in how food interacts with gut bacteria to strengthen the immune system's response to cancer.

itens.titulo: Even moderate drinking linked to cancer and early death, major study finds
itens.resumo: A major new study challenges the idea that moderate drinking is safe, finding that even relatively small amounts of alcohol increase the risk of cancer, heart disease, and premature death. Researchers found no overall health benefits from drinking and warn that consuming more than one alcoholic beverage per day can significantly increase long-term health risks.

itens.titulo: Scientists discover a surprising brain benefit of eating peanuts every day
itens.resumo: A surprising new study suggests that eating peanuts every day could help support brain health and memory in older adults. Researchers found that consuming about two servings of unsalted, skin-roasted peanuts daily for 16 weeks improved insulin responsiveness in brain regions important for memory, a function that often weakens with age and has been linked to Alzheimer's disease.

itens.titulo: Scientists find surprisingly little evidence that medical cannabis helps you sleep
itens.resumo: A major new review challenges the growing enthusiasm for medical cannabis as an insomnia treatment, finding little reliable evidence that it improves sleep quality, sleep duration, or daytime functioning. Researchers caution that this doesn't mean cannabis is ineffective, only that existing studies are too weak to establish whether it works.

itens.titulo: Scientists discover new Alzheimer’s drug that repairs DNA damage and reduces brain inflammation
itens.resumo: Scientists have discovered that a drug originally developed for spinal cord injuries can tackle several key features of Alzheimer’s disease, including DNA damage and inflammation. Already tested for initial safety in humans, the experimental treatment could offer a faster path toward therapies that target the disease at its roots.

itens.titulo: Experts say high blood pressure guidelines are missing half the equation

A new report finds that combining increased potassium intake with reduced sodium consumption may offer greater benefits for blood pressure control than sodium reduction alone.

itens.titulo: Drinking tea may help protect your heart, but there’s a surprising catch
itens.resumo: A massive study of nearly 486,000 adults found that regularly drinking tea was associated with an 11% lower risk of heart and blood vessel diseases. Acompanhe pela abordagem de longevidade, capacidade física e manutenção da saúde ao longo dos anos. Para a marca Luan Tavares Treinador, isso ajuda a ampliar a conversa para além da estética: força para envelhecer melhor, autonomia e capacidade de realizar atividades cotidianas.

Aqui existe uma oportunidade comercial interessante. Muitas pessoas acima dos 35 anos não querem se tornar atletas. Querem ter um corpo que funcione bem, sentir-se seguras e continuar fazendo o que gostam.

Este é o perfil que eu observaria fora do universo tradicional dos treinadores. A Red Bull transforma esportes em histórias visuais: existe um protagonista, um desafio, uma dificuldade e um desfecho.

Pense na aplicação disso ao seu estúdio. Em vez de simplesmente mostrar um aluno executando um exercício, você pode contar a história de alguém que voltou a treinar depois de anos, conquistou confiança ou conseguiu realizar algo que antes parecia difícil. Com autorização do aluno, esse tipo de narrativa pode demonstrar valor de uma maneira que uma sequência de exercícios não consegue.
